name: 1,4-anhydro-D-glucitol 6-dodecanoate
description: 1,4-Anhydro-D-glucitol 6-dodecanoate (CAS 5959-89-7 ) is a sorbitan-based fatty acid ester derived from sorbitol and lauric acid. It functions as a nonionic emulsifier, wetting agent, and humectant across food, personal care, and industrial formulations. In food manufacturing, it stabilizes oil-in-water emulsions in baked goods, confectionery coatings, and fat-based spreads where consistent texture and shelf stability are required for high-quality production. Personal care formulators use it to improve emulsion stability and skin feel in creams, lotions, and cleansing products. Its moisturizing character also supports hydration retention in various topical applications. Home care and industrial cleaning products incorporate it as a low-foam wetting agent to improve substrate penetration and soil release. This makes it an essential component for high-performance cleaning solutions. In textile and leather processing, it aids surface modification by improving fiber wettability and dye uptake uniformity during finishing operations. This ensures consistent color and texture across different materials. Supplied as a liquid or paste depending on temperature and concentration, it is versatile for many systems. Standard commercial grades include food-grade and technical-grade specifications for diverse needs. Food-grade material typically conforms to FCC or relevant regional food additive standards.
